policy.rule: Lists the security-boundary and wire-contract code whose unit-test line coverage must reach the target. Coverage comes from tests that assert an invariant, never from assertion-free calls. Adding a file or exclusion needs a reason; tests still obey tests/critical-test-budget.json.
policy.integrationOnly: Functions that need a live database, network, OS keychain, or child process are excluded from the target and listed with the reason. They are covered by integration suites such as provider-postgres, not by unit tests.

src-tauri/src/connection/runtime/authori.authorize_pin: Asks the remote workspace authority and provider-local port over the network before a pool is opened
src-tauri/src/connection/runtime/authori.connect_authorized: Opens a live driver pool, SSH tunnel, or Cloud SQL connector and holds a managed lease
src-tauri/src/connection/runtime/authori.open_live: Starts the system ssh tunnel or Cloud SQL connector process and connects a live driver
src-tauri/src/connection/runtime/authori.retire_opened: Closes live pools, tunnels, connector processes, and managed leases

src-tauri/src/safety/l2_enforce.rs.run_read_only_cancellable: Its uncovered branch dispatches to the BigQuery service over the network
src-tauri/src/safety/l2_enforce.rs.run_read_only_byte_capped_cancellable: Its uncovered branch dispatches to the BigQuery service over the network
src-tauri/src/safety/l2_enforce.rs.run_read_only_inner: The Postgres and MySQL read-only transaction branches need a live server; SQLite runs in unit tests
src-tauri/src/safety/l2_enforce.rs.run_read_only_byte_capped_inner: The Postgres and MySQL read-only transaction branches need a live server; SQLite runs in unit tests

src-tauri/src/safety/l3_preview.rs.explain: Issues engine-specific EXPLAIN statements against a live Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, or Cloudflare D1 target
